data.change_summary: Implemented the three pending amendments for the canonical chemistry helper follow-up. Removed the dead `_volume_l` parameters from the private shrimp daily helpers so `step_daily_shrimp` only keeps the net-water zero guard at the entry point; extracted the decomposer dissolved-oxygen Monod half-saturation into `ProcessParams`/`ProcessParamsPreset` as `decomposer_k_do_mg` and wired nitrogen-cycle runtime plus default preset data through that canonical parameter; and fixed startup substrate/source-water overrides so they rebuild `WaterState` from the effective source-water profile instead of rescaling possibly zeroed totals, which restores correct dissolved chemistry when low-fill materialization starts at zero net volume and a shallower substrate later creates water volume. Added regression coverage for the new decomposer DO tunability and the zero-volume startup override path.
outstanding_risks: Decomposer DOC and DO half-saturation parameters remain expressed in total-mass units for this phase; the broader concentration-based kinetic normalization is still deferred to the downstream normalization beads.

Startup substrate or source-water overrides now intentionally rebuild dissolved chemistry from the effective source-water profile; if a future startup flow needs to preserve intentionally pre-aged non-source chemistry across substrate swaps, that will require an explicit alternate mode rather than reuse of this path.

steps.description: Inspected the shrimp lifecycle helpers, nitrogen-cycle decomposer kinetics, startup override materialization path, and existing regression coverage to map each pending amendment onto the concrete code and tests that needed changes.

Removed the dead private shrimp helper volume parameters, added `decomposer_k_do_mg` to runtime/process preset plumbing and default data, and updated decomposer mineralization to use the new tunable parameter instead of a hardcoded DO half-saturation constant.

Refactored startup override water handling so source-water or substrate overrides resolve the effective source-water profile and rebuild `WaterState` from that profile at the post-override net water volume, fixing the zero-volume-to-positive-volume substrate override bug.
Added regression tests for decomposer DO half-saturation tunability and the zero-volume startup override recovery path, then formatted and validated the workspace.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -q -p tank_core --test cycling` completed successfully with the new `decomposer_do_half_saturation_is_tunable` regression passing.
`cargo test -q -p tank_scenarios --test startup_overrides` completed successfully with the new zero-volume substrate override regression passing.
`cargo test --quiet` completed successfully across the workspace.
A final `rg` check found no remaining private shrimp helper signatures or call sites carrying the dead `_volume_l` parameter.
No `.beads/` files changed in this remediation pass, so `br lint` was not required.
